synthetic_data_notice: All metrics are measured on the synthetic V4 benchmark (training_v4.csv). They describe generalisation across synthetic scenario families/archetypes, NOT real-world wildfire detection accuracy.

evaluation_design.primary: grouped_family_cv: 5 folds, whole scenario families held out (2 fire + 2 no-fire families per fold)
evaluation_design.family_fold_caveat: The frozen fold layout deals families round-robin by name, so a fold can hold out EVERY family of one evidence shape (e.g. both satellite-only fire families in family_fold_2, whose collapse it explains). That is a property of the evaluation layout, not a dataset bug. It is NOT what limits performance: the supplementary leave-one-family-out check (sibling families kept in training) does not score better overall (see leave_one_family_out_supplementary; it also has its own bias - single-label groups and pooled predictions from 20 different models). Weaknesses that persist under both layouts are per-family, see subgroups_at_threshold_0.5.
evaluation_design.thresholds_calibration_importance: computed from out-of-fold grouped predictions only
evaluation_design.hyperparameters: fixed a priori with moderate regularisation; not tuned on evaluation splits

rule_baseline.note: FireDetectionCalculator evaluated against ground-truth labels; fire = SUSPECTED or CONFIRMED.

steps.note: includes fire_danger_available, which is a real binary feature and is never imputed

random_split_diagnostic.note: Random split - diagnostic only. Not used for model selection.

leave_one_family_out_supplementary.note: SUPPLEMENTARY diagnostic, not used for the gate or selection: one family held out at a time (its sibling families stay in training). Pooled out-of-fold metrics from 20 different models; each held-out group has a single label, which biases this design against the held-out family (removing it makes its evidence look more like the opposite label).

assessment.rule: recommend only if Brier improves by >= 0.005 AND grouped ROC-AUC does not drop by more than 0.005

permutation_importance_grouped.metric: drop in held-out ROC-AUC when the feature (or block) is shuffled

standardized_coefficients_grouped_folds.note: Coefficients of the standardised, median-imputed inputs (comparable magnitudes); mean over the grouped folds.

standardized_coefficients_full_fit.note: Coefficients of the standardised, median-imputed inputs (comparable magnitudes); mean over the grouped folds.
